diseases.name: Conjunctivitis
diseases.intro: Conjunctivitis is a health condition that affects many people and can often be relieved with simple home measures alongside medical guidance.
home_remedies: 🌡️ Soak a clean cloth in warm (not hot) water, wring out, and press gently over closed eyes for 10 minutes. Repeat 3× daily.
💧 Mix ¼ tsp salt in 1 cup cooled boiled water. Use a sterile dropper to rinse each eye gently twice a day.
💦 Run a humidifier at 40–50% humidity in your bedroom — dry air is a major trigger for eye irritation.
🥤 Drink 8+ glasses of water daily — systemic hydration directly improves tear film quality.
doctor_visit_if: Eye discharge is thick or greenish yellow
Vision is significantly blurred or suddenly lost
You have diabetes or a known immune disorder

home_remedies: 🧴 Apply a thick fragrance-free moisturiser (like CeraVe or Vaseline) within 3 minutes of getting out of the shower to lock in moisture.
✂️ Keep nails trimmed short and smooth — long nails cause deep scratch wounds that introduce bacteria and scar.
🧊 Wrap ice cubes in a thin cloth and apply to itchy area for 10 minutes — cold stops the itch-scratch cycle immediately.
🧼 Use only fragrance-free, pH-balanced soap or just water on affected areas. Rinse thoroughly — soap residue causes irritation.
📓 Keep a trigger diary: note food, detergent, stress, and weather each time symptoms flare — patterns appear within 2 weeks.
doctor_visit_if: Symptoms do not improve after 2–3 weeks of home treatment
Rash spreads rapidly or covers a large body area
Skin becomes infected (increasing warmth, pus, red streaking)

home_remedies: 💊 Take paracetamol 500–1000mg (adults) every 4–6 hours OR ibuprofen 400mg every 6–8 hours with food. Never combine both at the same time.
💦 Use a saline nasal spray (2 sprays each nostril) every 4 hours to keep nasal passages moist and clear.
💧 Set a timer: drink 200ml of fluid every 30 minutes. Fever causes 500ml+ extra fluid loss per day through sweating.
🧊 Soak a face cloth in cool (15°C) water, wring out, and place on forehead, neck, and wrists. Re-soak every 5 minutes.
doctor_visit_if: Stiff neck, sensitivity to light, or confusion develop
A seizure occurs
Fever lasts more than 3 days without improvement

diseases.name: Sprain (Ankle)
diseases.intro: Sprain (Ankle) refers to inflammation, dysfunction, or infection of related structures that requires appropriate care to resolve.
home_remedies: 💉 Check your tetanus vaccination status for any puncture wound — if not vaccinated in 10 years, seek a booster within 24 hours.
🚿 For cuts: hold under cool running water for 5–10 minutes to clean. Never use hydrogen peroxide — it damages healing tissue.
🧊 RICE step 1 — Rest: Stop all activity immediately. Weight-bearing on a sprain within the first hour doubles healing time.
🛋️ RICE step 4 — Elevate: Prop injured limb on 2–3 pillows so it is above heart level. Do this 3+ hours daily for the first 48 hours.
doctor_visit_if: Signs of infection: increasing redness, warmth, pus, red streaking
A burn is larger than the palm of your hand or affects the face, hands, or genitals
Wound does not stop bleeding after 10 minutes of direct pressure
